name: In a New World
source:
Welcome to In a New World, a Visual Novel where you will play Riu, a human who has arrived in a whole new world full of talking animals. With no memories of his past, he will have to venture into this world discovering what brought him to this world, not forgetting the new friends he will find in it. Are you ready to start your adventure in this new world?

[From [url=https://riupix.itch.io/in-a-new-world]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到《In a New World》。在这部视觉小说中，你将扮演人类利乌，来到一个满是会说话的动物的全新世界。他对过去毫无记忆，只能在这个世界中展开冒险，探寻自己为何会来到这里，同时结识新的朋友。你准备好开启这场异世界冒险了吗？

[摘自[url=https://riupix.itch.io/in-a-new-world]Itch.io[/url]]
